final: WITH a AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL)/l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE CAST(l.CPK AS REAL)/l.GPT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m FROM a), s1 AS (SELECT a.sex, a.avg_ratio FROM a, m1 WHERE a.avg_ratio > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.sex, s1.avg_ratio FROM s1, m2 WHERE s1.avg_ratio > m2.m) SELECT AVG(s2.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s2.avg_ratio - m1.m) AS above_first_mean, AVG(s2.avg_ratio - m2.m) AS above_second_mean FROM s2, m1, m2
